levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» is the compiler's father, written only as «أبي»: relation (rule 7)
«وَ مُحَمَّدُ [بْنُ‌] الْحَسَنِ» : the editor's bracket is read as «بن»; «قالا» makes the two a pair at one level
The Imam after «عن» stays narrator; «قُلْتُ لَهُ» is the narrator's question, and the answer is the Imam's words
